bg.$description: The surface a key-value list sits on: the pure black page (BR-03). The list has no fill of its own.

label.$description: Color of the label of a row: the muted text color, so the value is the stronger of the two.

value.$description: Color of the value of a row: the default text color.

color.$description: Color of the line between two rows. It is the separator's line color, so it passes the 3:1 minimum for a UI element.

width.$description: Stroke width of the line between two rows (BR-13). The same stroke as the separator.
